pages.en:
“————”

…We have little choice but to accept.

Enemy or not, he is right.

Tohsaka and I cannot defeat Caster and her allies alone.

But with Lancer's help, we may at least see a glimmer of hope.

pages.ja:
「………分かった。俺も、共闘する事に文句はない」
全身に繋げた魔術回路をオフにして、肩の力を抜く。
それが自分に出来る精一杯の誠意だ。
戦う気はない、と。
共闘する以上は、こちらも無防備に背中を見せるという意思表示。

pages.en:
“………All right. I have no objection to fighting together either.”

I shut down the Magic Circuits engaged throughout my body and let the tension leave my shoulders.

——It is the strongest gesture of good faith I can offer.

I have no intention of fighting him.

If we are to fight side by side, I am willing to show him my undefended back.

“——I see. You're a hopeless case. No wonder the young lady has her hands full.”

“Oh, you can tell? Thank goodness. I've finally met someone who understands. I was beginning to worry he might stay like this all the way to the end.”

“My condolences. Still, it's not a bad way for a man to be.

“When you're young, there's nothing wrong with being thickheaded to the point of idiocy.

“You can pick up cheap cleverness and grow cynical afterward.”

pages.en:
With that answer, Lancer begins walking toward us.

The crimson spear is no longer in his hand.

As if in answer to my decision to stand down, Lancer has dismissed his own weapon as well.
